headline: Fisherman's Row Swings Back to Wardens as Callahan's Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition, Fisherman's Row has swung back toward the Wardens, who now count five of nine posts to three Colonial and one in ruins, with forty-five base events logged in the past day and exchanges fresh to press time about Eidolo and Black Well. The Stlican Shelf has likewise returned a post to Warden hands, six-three Colonial, Breaker Town alone accounting for thirty-one events. Callahan's Passage has not changed hands since early afternoon, yet its casualty ledger climbs at a fearful rate, near fifteen hundred an hour on either side in the latest hour. The Weathered Expanse holds its five-four line, Warden losses running near a thousand an hour against some seven hundred Colonial around Frostmarch and Wightwalk. Mooring County's guns, silent at our last filing, have resumed, while the Nevish Line now reads seven-one to the Wardens with its earlier ruin gone from the ledger. Marban Hollow and Linn Mercy register fresh exchanges, and most hinterland fronts report only a trickle. It is day 410; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
